description: Same SoC as chipyard_dual_rocket_gemmini_q31.json, but the Saturn e-core is declared kind 'rvv_f16' so schedules whose CPU_E slots carry fp16 ops (e.g. vint's mixed-precision graph) resolve. Identical hardware -- the Saturn V256D128 already provides Zfh/Zvfh; only the registry KIND label changes, which is what ingest_xpurt_schedule.py matches CPU_E#0 against.

cores.name: gemmini_q31_0
cores.description: Rocket with saturn vector + gemmini Q0.31 accelerator. Routes int8 conv2d/linear via gemmini's ROCC tiled_conv_auto path with Q0.31 acc_scale fold; falls back to scalar/RVV for ops gemmini can't accelerate.

cores.name: rvv0
cores.description: Rocket with saturn vector only (no gemmini). Handles RVV-int8 conv2d / linear, plus all the non-int8 / non-conv ops (silu, sigmoid, batchnorm, maxpool, relu, add, cat, upsample) that fall back to scalar/RVV everywhere. (kind relabelled rvv_f16)
